deviations: Suites were run from a subst drive mapped to the worktree. From the full worktree path, Queue_Import_FromPreparedPackage_WritesTargetSideIdMapAndProgress fails with SQLite Error 14 because Checkpoints/idmap.db plus its journal file exceed 260 characters. The same test passes from the shorter path; this is environmental and pre-existing, not caused by this change.

The old-orchestrator skills (start-session, fix, review, end-session, session-hooks) were kept despite an earlier approval to delete them: end-session is the ADR-0033 session-evidence emitter and is referenced by the Constitution.
risks: Spec Kit reports unsafe-multi-install because Copilot is not declared multi-install safe; the integrations write disjoint paths apart from the shared .agents/skills/speckit-* files, which carry the Claude variant.
Long-path limit: SQLite package files under deep paths can fail on Windows (see deviations); this affects real users with deep package locations, not only tests.
